entry.title: NIS 2 Directive: draft implementing regulation open for feedback
entry.summary: Common incident reporting templates under the NIS2 Directive: a draft by the Commission services, not adopted; feedback until 22 Dec 2026. The NIS2 Directive sets out obligations on essential and important entities in 18 critical sectors in the EU for the reporting of significant cybersecurity incidents. This act will provide common incident notification templates for notifications under the NIS2 Directive, thereby streamlining the format and the type of information to be notified across all 27 Member States and supporting the Commission’s broader simplification agenda.

entry.title: Cybersecurity Act 2: debate in Parliament
entry.summary: The Irish Council Presidency (Marian Harkin) reported progress on the three main parts of the Cybersecurity Act revision (ENISA, certification, ICT supply chains) and aims for agreement in the Council by the end of 2026, so that trilogues can start in 2027. Executive Vice-President Virkkunen put supply chain security at the core of the proposal, called for clear timelines to phase out high-risk suppliers, above all in 5G networks, and urged Parliament to give ENISA the mandate and resources it needs; she said full transposition and effective implementation of the NIS2 Directive could potentially have prevented some recent incidents or reduced their impact. Of the shadow rapporteurs, Tomas Tobé (EPP) asked for quick adoption with a framework to phase out high-risk suppliers, Jens Geier (S&D) for extending the scope to energy networks, and Markus Buchheit (ESN) opposed more resources for ENISA, a central reporting point and new certificates.

entry.title: NIS-2 amendment: EP committee vote close to the end of its window
entry.summary: The forecast expects it around 1 Feb 2027. It keeps its median of publication only if the step comes by 16 Dec 2026; on 17 Nov 2026 that left 29 days. Until 16 Dec 2026 the median of publication in the Official Journal stays within 14 days of 25 Aug 2027, the median of 25 Mar 2026, when the procedure reached its current step; later, it moves later with every week. If the step came on 17 Nov 2026, the median would be 31 Jul 2027.
